conditions.text: Prototype use only. Production use is not supported: N2 (traffic counts without a station mapping) and N3 humidity (no source) are not closed.
Confirm the UCI research-only note against CC BY 4.0, and whether warning use is permitted, before any prototype output is shared.
Treat -200 as null in all numeric UCI columns, including benzene, before any analysis.
Read the Eurostat reuse terms at source before any use of the N6 national context figures.
Confirm the status of station VR-03 (catalog says active; wiki says switched off on 2024-06-30) before any production use of station readings.

agreements.reason: Agree with feasible_with_conditions for N1 prototype only. The missing-value coding (-200) and the single-site limitation are real and are recorded as conditions.
Agree with not_feasible: licence unknown and partial window coverage (2005 only within the prototype window; no production years). The accepted use is prototype context only.
Agree: refused by the guardrail (host not allowlisted) and US geography. The refusal is the recorded finding.
Agree the N3 humidity gap: the configured variables are temperature and shortwave radiation only, and no candidate supplies humidity for production.

overrides.reason: Dismiss the FRS-STALE flag under calibration rule 5, because the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) is historical. The verdict stays feasible_with_conditions. The agent kept the flag and recorded no dismissal, so this override is recorded here and not in discovery_results.json.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: Station readings for the prototype window (before 2023-01-01) are supplied by the Environment Monitoring Unit. That would change the statement that internal data cannot serve N1 prototype.
